**Short answer:** For a MacBook Pro, the Anker Prime 26K (300W) is the best all-around pick. If you want to spend less, the Baseus Blade H1 or ReelCharge ReelPro are cheaper options.

## Top picks

**Anker Prime Power Bank (26,250 mAh, 300W): best overall, about $200-$230**
- Macworld's top pick. It has two USB-C ports at 140W (PD 3.1), which fast-charges even a 16" MacBook Pro.
- At 99.75Wh it stays under the 100Wh airline limit.
- Macworld fully charged a 14" M2 MacBook Pro with enough left over for a second partial recharge.
- The charger isn't built in, but it comes with a USB-C cable.
- Review and deal links: https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html

**EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W): best with a built-in cable, about $190-$220**
- 99.54Wh, with two 140W USB-C ports and a retractable cable that also delivers 140W.
- It has a 300W total output and recharges very fast.
- Wired lists it at $190 on Amazon, and Macworld lists it at $219.99.
- Macworld review: https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html
- Wired roundup: https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/

**ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000 mAh, 200W): best value for the capacity, about $120**
- Its USB-C and USB-A ports are both rated at 100W, and the built-in cable delivers up to 140W.
- It has a 3-year warranty, but ReelCharge is a new brand, so Wired calls it a slightly riskier buy.
- Wired roundup: https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/

**Baseus Blade H1 (20,000 mAh, 100W): budget-friendly, $89.99**
- At about 74Wh it's carry-on legal, and 100W is enough for a 14" MacBook Pro.
- Baseus doesn't publish how power is split across ports, so expect less than 100W to the laptop if you charge a phone at the same time.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah (affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy)
- That page says the Blade H1 is "the only bank" with enough output for a MacBook Pro. The other sources above show that's wrong, since several banks deliver 100-140W.

## How to choose
- **14" MacBook Pro:** 100W is enough, so the Baseus or ReelCharge works fine.
- **16" MacBook Pro:** Get a 140W (PD 3.1) bank like the Anker Prime or EcoFlow for the fastest charging.
- **Flying:** Keep the bank under 100Wh. All the picks above are, though the Anker and EcoFlow are right at the limit.
- **Real-world capacity:** Expect roughly 70-75% of a large MacBook battery per charge, because some power is lost in transfer.

If you tell me which MacBook Pro you have and your budget, I can narrow it to one pick.
